Definition: properly, to wrench, i.e. (figuratively) to subvert
BiblicalUsage: In Deuteronomy we find çâlaph, the word for to wrench, by figure to subvert. Plainly used, and no mystery about what it means.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe çâlaph is worth a moment of attention, and I think you will see why when you read the verse.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
